applicationComponents.label: Design Assistant Backend
applicationComponents.summary: Flask backend serving both the internal employee API and the customer portal API; orchestrates the three-model AI pipeline, documents, workspaces and async work.

applicationComponents.label: Design Assistant Frontend
applicationComponents.summary: Employee-facing management SPA (customers, projects, documents, inbox, review), served by nginx and consuming the backend API.

applicationComponents.label: Design Assistant Portal
applicationComponents.summary: Customer-facing workspace SPA (workspace entry, chat, content panel), served by nginx and consuming the backend API.

applicationComponents.label: Design Assistant Manuals
applicationComponents.summary: Static nginx site serving the generated employee and portal help markdown, proxied by the frontend and portal under /docs.

applicationComponents.label: Design Assistant Canon Docs
applicationComponents.summary: Static nginx/VitePress site serving the generated Canon reference and UAT documentation, proxied by the frontend under /docs.

applicationComponents.label: DHCP Monitoring App
applicationComponents.summary: Backend for the homelab DHCP management app — reads dnsmasq lease/config data and streams real-time updates over a REST API and SSE.

applicationComponents.label: DHCP Monitoring UI
applicationComponents.summary: React single-page web UI for the homelab DHCP app — renders the live DHCP lease table with real-time updates, served as static assets behind NGINX.

applicationComponents.label: Backup Server
applicationComponents.summary: Accepts authenticated backup uploads, encrypts them per scope with age, and streams them to a cloud destination via rclone; also exposes a Terraform-facing credential-management API.

applicationComponents.label: Calendar Support
applicationComponents.summary: HTTP service that reads an upstream Google Calendar and exposes selected events as an OIDC-protected JSON API.

applicationComponents.label: Certbot
applicationComponents.summary: Certificate manager that issues/renews TLS certificates over ACME — public Let's Encrypt for public endpoints and the homelab step-ca for internal ones — for the custom NGINX ingress.

applicationComponents.label: dnsmasq Config Generator
applicationComponents.summary: Renders dnsmasq static config (one-shot init) and dynamic config from Kubernetes Services and reservation records, SIGHUPing dnsmasq on change.

applicationComponents.label: dnsmasq Management API
applicationComponents.summary: Bearer-authenticated REST API for managing DHCP host reservations, auto-allocating IPs and triggering a dnsmasq config refresh on change.

applicationComponents.label: Document Conversion
applicationComponents.summary: HTTP service that converts documents between formats — extracting Markdown/text from PDF and DOCX (PyMuPDF/Pandoc) and rendering Markdown back to Word or PDF.

applicationComponents.label: Elasticsearch Setup
applicationComponents.summary: One-shot bootstrap job that waits for Elasticsearch and sets the built-in user passwords (kibana_system, logstash) after the cluster starts.

applicationComponents.label: ESP32 Coredump Parser
applicationComponents.summary: HTTP service that parses ESP32 (Xtensa/RISC-V) coredumps against an ELF binary into readable GDB backtraces.

applicationComponents.label: Git Sync
applicationComponents.summary: Scheduled job that mirrors GitHub repositories into bare mirror clones for the internal gitblit git server, maintaining gitblit branch/tag indexing.

applicationComponents.label: Infra Statistics
applicationComponents.summary: HTTP service that aggregates homelab infrastructure statistics from the Jenkins and Kubernetes APIs (build history, node metrics, container starts).

applicationComponents.label: NGINX Configurator
applicationComponents.summary: Watches Kubernetes Service annotations and generates NGINX reverse-proxy configuration for the custom ingress, coordinating certificate requests with certbot.

applicationComponents.label: Rclone Backup
applicationComponents.summary: Scheduled job that syncs remote backups (rclone remotes) into local ZFS snapshots.

applicationComponents.label: Registry Cleanup
applicationComponents.summary: Scheduled job that removes old numeric image tags from the internal Docker registry (keeping the most recent N per repository) and triggers garbage collection.

applicationComponents.label: Scan Server
applicationComponents.summary: HTTP service that drives a SANE-compatible document scanner and stores the scanned image, returning its filename.

applicationComponents.label: Scanned Image Processing
applicationComponents.summary: HTTP service that post-processes scanned images — edge-detected rotate/crop and Tesseract-based orientation detection.

applicationComponents.label: Version Poller
applicationComponents.summary: Polls upstream registries and Helm repositories for new versions of deployed images and charts and triggers the matching Jenkins rebuild pipeline when it detects drift from what is currently deployed.

applicationComponents.label: Electronics Inventory
applicationComponents.summary: Flask BFF backend for the hobby electronics parts inventory.

applicationComponents.label: Electronics Inventory UI
applicationComponents.summary: React + Vite single-page web app (SPA) for the hobby electronics parts inventory.

applicationComponents.label: Ginbov.nl

applicationComponents.label: Gitblit MCP Support Plugin
applicationComponents.summary: Gitblit plugin adding an internal REST API (/api/.mcp-internal) used by the Gitblit MCP server to read repositories, files, and history. Packaged as the gitblit-initializer image.

applicationComponents.label: Gitblit MCP Server
applicationComponents.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI assistants read access to Gitblit-hosted Git repositories (repo/file browsing, content and commit search) by delegating to the Gitblit Search API Plugin.
